snapshot.scope: Aggregate means/SDs/paired t intervals, confusion-count F1, label agreement and raw-duration summaries verified; no recomputation of per-record accuracy or station-bootstrap draws without data.

installed_wheel_checks.dependencies: Wheel installed with --no-deps --target; dependencies reused from the existing Python environment. Not a clean dependency-resolution test.

data_policy: No observational waveforms, label vectors, station/sample catalogs or per-record predictions. Public aggregates and duration arrays only.
